import datetime, os
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

def make_cover(path, title, date_str):
    """Build a minimal one-page PDF (letter size) with a title and date."""
    objs = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
        b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R /F2 6 0 R >> >> /Contents 4 0 R >>",
    ]
    text = (f"BT /F1 32 Tf 72 500 Td ({title}) Tj ET\n"
            f"BT /F2 16 Tf 72 455 Td ({date_str}) Tj ET\n").encode("latin-1")
    objs.append(b"<< /Length " + str(len(text)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" + text + b"\nendstream")
    objs.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>")
    objs.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")

    pdf = b"%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objs, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(pdf))
        pdf += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode() + obj + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(pdf)
    pdf += f"xref\n0 {len(objs)+1}\n".encode()
    pdf += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets[1:]:
        pdf += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    pdf += (b"trailer\n<< /Size " + str(len(objs)+1).encode()
            + b" /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode() + b"\n%%EOF")
    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(pdf)

if not os.path.exists("report.pdf"):
    print("ERROR: report.pdf not found in the workspace")
    raise SystemExit(1)

# Replace report.pdf with the version that has the cover page

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title and current date."""
import datetime
import os

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

REPORT = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
COVER = "cover.pdf"

# 1. Create the cover page
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 250, "Annual Financial Report")

# Current date
today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height - 300, today)

# Decorative line
c.setLineWidth(2)
c.line(width / 2.0 - 150, height - 280, width / 2.0 + 150, height - 280)

c.save()
print(f"Created {COVER}")

# 2. Merge cover with report
reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Created {OUTPUT} with {len(reader.pages) + 1} pages")
